fields.description: Upsert key — re-polling an already-known active job updates last_seen/elapsed_seconds instead of creating a duplicate row. Row is deleted outright once this ID no longer appears in a push (job finished or its worker died).
fields.label: RQ Job ID

fields.description: The enqueued method's dotted path (from job.kwargs' own job_name/method, not rq's constant job.func_name) — same derivation as Frappe Failed Job Log's Job Name.
fields.label: Job Name

fields.description: OS PID of the RQ worker process executing this job — cross-reference against Frappe Worker Health Log's Live Worker PIDs to spot which specific worker is stuck.
fields.label: Worker PID

fields.description: RQ's own job.started_at, as reported by the agent — the source of truth for how long this job has actually been running, not when we first observed it.
fields.label: Started At

fields.description: Updated every poll this job is still active.
fields.label: Last Seen

fields.description: (last_seen - started_at) at the most recent push, computed server-side so the dashboard doesn't need to re-derive it from two timestamps just to sort/filter.
fields.label: Elapsed (seconds)

fields.description: elapsed_seconds at/beyond Host Monitor Settings' Long-Running Job Critical Threshold at the most recent push.
fields.label: Is Long Running
